confidence_notes: Holistic estimate of Melbourne price levels for July 2026 from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. July is an off-peak winter month, so accommodation anchors reflect winter rates. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are firmer; hostel and hotel anchors are wider. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 1.3x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page. I did not open that page or the F11.1 table, and a follow-up search did not confirm the figure, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors reflect Melbourne's own price level for CBD and inner-city cafes, restaurants, bars, hostels and hotels, based on general knowledge of Australian capital-city pricing. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
